global: This shoyu ramen features a rich, amber broth with tender chashu pork and menma bamboo shoots. A mound of finely sliced green onions crowns the noodles in a white bowl with red geometric trim, set against a dark tabletop under soft, even lighting.

regions.background: Dark blue textured table surface with subtle sheen and faint creases visible beneath the bowl.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with red geometric pattern and blue characters, smooth glossy surface, slightly raised rim.
regions.soup: Shoyu ramen broth with noodles, garnished with sliced green onions, appears rich, golden-brown, and glossy.
regions.meat: Chashu pork appears as tender, browned, slightly fatty slices with a glistening surface and irregular, soft edges.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear light brown, slightly translucent, with fibrous texture and irregular, curled shapes.
